title: Playing in the country band at Leclerc after 1913; reading and playing by head
summary: Joseph returned to Leclerc in 1913 and played with the Holmes men, the only band there; they all read music and played by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here. So I was here. In fact, all of them was good musicians. I played with them. After I went back to Leclerc in 1913, I played with them. Do they have many bands around Leclerc?
Only band. Only band. No white band?
Way after they started. Could any of those guys play by head? Sure they all could play by head.
All of them. That's right. And they all read too?
All musicians. All read. All of them.
What would they play by music and what would they play by head?
Mm-hmm. Play it by head. Because I never had a piece of music in front of me. First time I ever had a piece of music in front of me, I always got a saxophone.
Mm-hmm. That man just had a lot of confidence in me. Any man missing, you figure out we replaced a man. That's Professor Holmes you mean.
